description_expanded: Hidden Lake 622 – Coastal Luxury Condo with Community Pool Favorite Features: - Community Pool - Gym & Fitness Center - Near Beach About Hidden Lake 622: Welcome to Hidden Lake 622, a stunning vacation rental located in Santa Rosa Beach, nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along scenic 30A. This beautifully designed condo offers modern coastal living, featuring an open-concept layout, upscale finishes, and spacious bedrooms with walk-in closets—perfect for families or groups seeking both comfort and style. Guests can unwind on the private balcony after a day at the beach or enjoy resort-style amenities including a gated entrance, community pool, fitness center, and outdoor gathering spaces. Ideally located just minutes from sugar-white sand beaches, local dining, and boutique shopping, Hidden Lake 622 is a prime short-term rental destination with strong guest appeal, making it an exceptional choice for a relaxing getaway or high-performing vacation rental investment along Florida’s iconic 30A corridor.
